engine.notes: Wichita's improv life centres on Flying Pig on East Douglas, with First Draft playing the melodrama house downtown and United Comedy Academy, a 2025 nonprofit, teaching through WSU. The Loony Bin is stand-up, and the Wichita Improv Meetup has no site of its own.

entries.name: Flying Pig Improv
entries.summary: Wichita's improv learning center and theater on East Douglas, founded by Jessie Gray, with two house troupes playing Friday and Saturday nights, a Thursday jam night, and drop-in classes for beginners, over-55s and long-form players.
entries.schedule: Shows Fri and Sat 8pm $15; Intro drop-in Sat 11am $10; long form Thu 7-9:30pm $20; Silver Improv Tue 11am from May 5 202
signals: Own theater at 2320 E Douglas Ave
Weekend shows plus a Thursday jam
Kids' Saturday drop-ins hosted with United Comedy Academy
entries.reasons: A theater of its own, weekend house shows and drop-ins most days earn it well, but the show page still carried last season's dates and the class ladder is colour-coded rather than levelled.

entries.name: First Draft Improv & Sketch Comedy
entries.summary: A short- and long-form improv and sketch troupe based at Mosley Street Melodrama, with a monthly show and a six-week FD 101 class on Thursday nights.
entries.schedule: Monthly show (next Oct 29 2026); FD 101 Thursdays 7-9pm, six weeks, $200
entries.reasons: A dated monthly show and a real class, but one level, a borrowed stage and no founding history on the site.

entries.name: United Comedy Academy
entries.summary: A nonprofit improv training organisation teaching long-form classes for adults through Wichita State's Community Education programme and kids' improv on Saturdays, with free workshops funded by a 2026 city arts grant and graduation shows.
entries.schedule: Free adult workshops under the 2026 grant; She-Nanigans Jul 11 and 18 2026; kids' drop-ins Sat 1:30pm at Flying Pig
signals: Kids' Bitty Improv and Fun Shticks
entries.reasons: A young nonprofit with grant-backed free workshops and classes for all ages, but it borrows every room and its own events page was empty at reading.
